purpose: Qualify new source-pinned deterministic column-parallel assembly against unmodified serial generator on the exact saved9600 grid; preserve actual raw CSC arrays and measure full-scale same-input performance.
source_admission: Exact H execution-source manifest and independent PASS_SCOPED with explicit NCP preparation admission must be bound in NCP_READY.json before --execute. Self-declared PASS is insufficient. Parent inputs and full dependency manifest remain exact.
grid: Original saved9600 energy bytes, SHA2566a76d3539115003b046a5861baca89b0a4ff966564627e04d9f6e8bc86be8292. Do not regenerate grid.

runtime.cpu_dispatch: Observe before calls; do not force or replace library/environment. Record exact executable/library paths, versions and hashes; PR40 runtime metadata is prior observation, not automatic current attestation.

schedule: For each repetition, run the two independent model serial references as separate bounded lanes; then the two candidate model lanes. Each lane has fresh child runtime. Reservation before each logical build; no rank-local duplicate budget. Both serial/candidate payloads persist in separate new paths. Entire command deadline covers admission, children, output assembly, comparison and terminal receipt; transfer/source restore excluded and separately timed.

resource.target_description: User64CPU128GB; verify actual affinity, visible cgroup hierarchy/quota, topology and memory bytes. Do not label logical CPUs as physical cores.
resource.memory_rule: Reserve max(16GiB,bounded_memory/8), use actual available working memory. Require24GiB working for paired references. Candidate parents+workers aggregate within working limit. Reduce workers to memory-admitted count before reservation; fewer than2/model yields typed resource HOLD. Poll child/process/cgroup memory with explicit measurement scope; terminate owned process groups on deadline, failure or admission loss.
resource.disk_rule: Require at least16GiB free for eight uncompressed CSC payloads, partial files, comparison and logs; source backup free space is separate.

acceptance.source: Exact source/input/runtime checks before build; immutable outputs; no dirty checkout overwrite.
acceptance.columns: Every requested0..9599 column evaluated exactly once per candidate logical build; sorted disjoint tiles and canonical CSC rows, no duplicates or FP reduction.
acceptance.correctness: Within each model/repetition, candidate data/indices/indptr/energy/rates/normalization diagnostics must exactly match fresh serial reference bytes. Also compare reference repetition2 toreference1. Preserve raw failures. No tolerance substitute.
acceptance.historical_identity: Compare to old reference and failed fingerprints informationally; do not require equality for fresh same-runtime qualification, do not call reconstruction the recovery of original persisted arrays, and do not automatically reuse old pulse/residence/source approval.
acceptance.performance: Report same-input build-and-persist wall for2repetitions including candidate worker startup/collection; lane and total coordinator wall separate, peakRSS scope explicit. Compute observed median ratio only. Correctness PASS does not imply speedup. If candidate slower, record PERFORMANCE_NOT_IMPROVED and do not promote performance.
acceptance.claim_ceiling: SAME_RUNTIME_FULL9600_ASSEMBLY_EQUIVALENCE only if actual exact comparisons and independent final review pass. No physical model/production/grid/oldF operator-binding closure or64-core speedup before measurements.

failure: First failure or timeout cancels all owned children, records reserved/completed/partial column counts, exit and wall. No automatic retry/reset. Collection of completed and failed evidence remains allowed and separately timed if command deadline is exhausted; do not call receipt overhead extra science time.
return: Include complete input outer bundle or exact payload, all fresh serial/candidate raw CSC+energy values and identities, first failures, source/runtime/resource records, actual calls/exits/timing, exact comparison, independent review, new additive draft PR and create-only complete Drive/Dropbox return. Do not return hashes without raw values.
